Title: Azure Machine Learning—New log streaming feature is now available

Body.Content:
Azure Machine Learning now has log streaming, which is the automatic update of log files at a frequent rate to eliminate constant page refresh. View your log files by toggling this feature on or off to easily debug during or after the machine learning experimentation process. To see the new log streaming feature, go to the Experimentation tab of the Azure Machine Learning studio dashboard and click Outputs + logs.

Learn more.
